title: Ermittlungen der BAO Ferrum: Vollstreckung eines Haftbefehls in Nordrhein-Westfalen und Sicherstellung von Vermögenswerten

extraction.summaryEn: A 42-year-old suspect linked to a Berlin group accused of shootings and extortion was arrested in Hamm, North Rhine-Westphalia, on a warrant issued by the Berlin investigation team. Assets worth roughly several hundred thousand euros have been provisionally seized from members of the group.
